authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-111 separate-compatibility-windows design contract: the closed surface list for this closure, the six cells per admitted surface, the meaning of migrations/bridges so they cannot authorize provider-frame translation, and the explicit deferral of the evidence/custody/replay-formats matrix with DR-113 (DR-202 F3). It applies nothing, does not fill numeric windows, does not self-admit extra rows, does not evaluate versionConstraint in DR-103 locks, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-111 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-111 a T2-02 candidate that extracts the eight-surface / six-cell schema, scopes slice 1 honestly, and refuses to treat 'bridges' as frame translation.

linesVerbatim: There is no shared `N/N-1/N-2` promise and no common version number. DR-111 must
set a separate read/write/migration/refusal matrix for each surface:
Each matrix declares current writer, supported readers, migrations/bridges,
future-major refusal, downgrade/no-return, and test evidence. A bundle selects
compatible independent releases; it cannot force same-version coupling.
Resolution is deterministic over the exact signed snapshot, lock constraints,
platform, requested profile, capabilities, compatibility matrices, pins/holds,
and policy. Candidate ordering and tie-breaks are canonical; cycles/conflicts
refuse. The concrete solver/lock encoding remains DR-103/107.

governingSources.role: D-002 slice surfaces; D-012 alias windows are NOT this row; D-015 T-2/T-3.
CANDIDATE successor under review. Exact-pin locks producible now; constrained requests wait on this row. Citing v3 does not accept it.

noSharedVersion: There is no shared N/N-1/N-2 promise and no common version number. A bundle cannot force same-version coupling.
bridgesMean: A bridge is a declared, versioned reader or writer adapter owned by the surface's matrix. It MUST NOT wrap, translate, normalize, reorder, reinterpret, merge, or assign new fates to semantic frames of an existing provider protocol (file 02 must-not; D-015 T-3). A 'bridge' that authors provider meaning is a failed successor.
